inventory_metadata.title: Pelagos Engine SFOC Library Source Inventory, Dimensional Governance & Evidence Matrix
inventory_metadata.governance_standard: Statutory Class and Engine Manufacturer Technical Documentation Integrity Standard

dimension_1_source_authenticity.definition: Whether the source and reported numerical values are traceable to the cited primary document.

values.DIRECTLY_VERIFIED: Primary manufacturer manual (MIM) or statutory document inspected and certified; table/section verified.
values.SOURCE_REPORTED: Cited or extracted from public manufacturer project guide diagrams or yard specifications; primary shop-test test bed report uninspected.
values.UNVERIFIED: Third-party or secondary literature claim lacking primary document traceability.

dimension_2_technical_applicability.definition: Whether the curve applies to an exact engine variant, an engine family, or only an aggregate research population.

values.EXACT_VARIANT: Curve matches exact engine model, variant, and rating layout (e.g. WinGD 5RT-flex50D Tier II at Rating Point R1).
values.FAMILY_REFERENCE: Curve represents generic engine family baseline or nominal project guide layout (e.g. MAN B&W S60ME-C family).
values.AGGREGATE_RESEARCH: Fleet-wide statistical average; not applicable to specific manufacturer engines.
values.UNAVAILABLE: Engine particulars or curve unindexed in public registers.

dimension_3_permitted_use.definition: Whether the source permits operational commercial use, research use, internal retention, or redistribution.

values.OPERATIONAL_PERMITTED: Explicitly licensed or open public domain data authorized for commercial automated calculations.
values.RESEARCH_ONLY: Publicly accessible technical manual (e.g. WinGD MIM) permitted for non-commercial research, benchmarking, and internal testing; commercial operational calculations prohibited without manufacturer license.
values.RESTRICTED_PENDING_PERMISSION: Proprietary manufacturer project guide (e.g. MAN B&W Project Guide); extraction, retention, and operational reuse are restricted under copyright without explicit licensing agreement.
values.AGGREGATE_RESEARCH_ONLY: Public statistical aggregation (e.g. IMO GHG Study); permitted for research comparisons only, not operational engine calculations.

9766944.applicability_rationale: Engine model verified via ClassNK-162819. Variant 6S60ME-C8.2 is source-reported from Oshima yard spec. Specific shop-test certificate is unindexed in public registers. Associated as family-level reference with explicit uncertainty flag; commercial operational use is restricted pending licensing.

9713430.applicability_rationale: Engine model verified via ClassNK-145541. Registered rated power is CSR 8,330 kW @ 80.5 rpm (derated from 9,660 kW MCR). Nominal manufacturer L1 curve is applicable only as family reference; commercial operational use is restricted pending licensing.

9753284.applicability_rationale: Exact engine model and Tier II variant are directly verified via DNV Vessel Register ID 34947. Manufacturer Marine Installation Manual (MIM Issue 05/2016, Table 1-2) provides certified baseline curve for RT-flex50-D Tier II at Rating Point R1. Permitted for internal research/benchmarking only; commercial operational calculations restricted without manufacturer license.

prohibited_inferences_and_engineering_bo.speed_to_power_barrier: SFOC indicates grams of fuel per kilowatt-hour of shaft mechanical energy at a specified relative load. It DOES NOT determine the brake power required to achieve a vessel speed through water. Converting speed to power requires naval architecture hydrodynamic modeling (Admiralty coefficient, Holtrop-Mennen, or CFD sea trial data) with valid displacement Delta = DWT + LDT.
prohibited_inferences_and_engineering_bo.dwt_displacement_boundary: Displacement is NEVER equal to DWT. A 82k DWT Kamsarmax has displacement ~95k MT. Substituting DWT for displacement underestimates resistance by ~15-20%.
prohibited_inferences_and_engineering_bo.extrapolation_prohibition: No extrapolation below min_load_percent or above max_load_percent is permitted. Engine behavior below 25-50% load is non-linear due to auxiliary blower operation and thermal inefficiencies.
prohibited_inferences_and_engineering_bo.mrv_separation: EU THETIS-MRV provides annual aggregate sea-time and distance-based consumption, encompassing weather, hull fouling, auxiliary boilers, and port idle. It MUST NOT be directly equated to an isolated main-engine manufacturer SFOC curve without full operational decomposing.
